saq.question: Explain Movements and Social with reference to Social Movements in Our Times.
saq.answer: 20 Social Movements in Our Times You may have witnessed many movements in which people participate in large numbers, try to understand some problem, decide in favour of some form of change and campaign actively for it. You may even have participated in some of them.

saq.question: Explain Sections and World with reference to Social Movements in Our Times.
saq.answer: During the first half of the 20th century, the world was dominated by the great wars, revolutions, emergence of German Fascism, Soviet Socialism, Western liberalism, national liberation movements etc. However, with the end of the Second World War and the independence of colonies and semi-colonies like India, China, Indonesia, Nigeria and Egypt by mid 1950s, a new era began in the world. This was an era of economic growth and prosperity for most of the countries, but also of growing tensions in many countries. Sections of societies which had long been denied equal rights came out asserting their rights.
